item.title: Rust-lang/rust is adopting an LLM policy
item.description:
📝 People who author PRs with LLM-generated code on rust-lang/rust. People who discover issues using LLMs and post them on rust-lang/rust. People who write issues or comments that directly quote an LLM on rust-lang/rust.
🔗 Read more: https://blog.rust-lang.org/inside-rust/2026/08/05/rust-langrust-is-adopting-an-llm-policy/
